pages.text: $(thing)Advanced Crucible $()have a faster melting speed than $(thing)Crucible $()and an additional function: $(l)automatic ejection of calcined products into finished products$()$(br2)The method to adjust the output direction is to hold a $(thing)Hammer $()and right-click on one side of the $(thing)Advanced Crucible $()to adjust it to the output side. Then, when the item is calcined, the $(thing)Advanced Crucible $()will attempt to automatically output to the container corresponding to this side.
